s: Kempten (an independent town in Allgäu, Swabia region, Bavaria, Germany; official name: Kempten (Allgäu))
Kempten.et: From Middle High German Kemptun, from Medieval Latin Campidona, Latin Campodūnum, from Gaulish Καμβοδουνον (Kambodounon), from Proto-Celtic *kambos (“crooked”) + *dūnom (“fortress”).
